title: 6-month Intracoronary Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) Evaluation of Three New Generation Drug Eluting Stent
brief_summary: Aim of this study is to compare at 6 months follow-up, endothelization and malapposition, evaluated by means of optical coherence tomography, in terms of number of struts not endothelized or malapposed, after the implantation of three new generation stent: Cre8, Biomatrix and Xience.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with stable angina or acute coronary syndromes submitted to coronary angioplasty on a coronary with a vessel diameter \> 2,5 mm

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known allergy to antithrombotic drugs or to other components of the stent studied Planned surgery 6 months within angioplasty
condition: Recurrent Angina After Coronary Stent Placement
